root:
Usage: maxplayer-trade [OPTIONS] --home <HOME> <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list       Publish a fixed lot and reserve its inputs; preflights both mints
  discover   Discover verified available lots across all configured relays
  cancel     Cancel an inactive lot and release its reserved inputs
  serve      Keep running to accept trades and recover existing money authorizations
  take       Take a lot within explicit debit, net-receipt and fee limits
  recover    One recovery pass; exit 2 if items remain pending. Does not wait for lock deadlines
  preflight  Check NUT-07/09/12/14, an active sat keyset, and clock skew <= 60 seconds
  fund       Create or resume keyed funding; lifetime cap is 100,000 sats per mint/home. Never pays invoices
  withdraw   Pay one exact BOLT11 invoice (max 100,000 sats), journaling inputs and change
  balance    Read spendable wallet balance without submitting existing money authorizations
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --home <HOME>    Private, exclusively owned journal and wallet directory. Never delete a funded home
      --relay <RELAY>  Relay URL (repeatable); defaults to nos.lol, relay.primal.net and offchain.pub
  -h, --help           Print help
